_comment: Web rubric template — same 5-point competence scale for all. dimensions[].anchors (5 strings) = BARS per criterion; when unbundle_bullets, optional dimensions[].facet_anchors = array of 5-string arrays, one per bullet, facet-specific BARS. Criterion text is draft; reconcile with Word masters via UPIC/GPIC.

scale_rows.label: Novice
scale_rows.description: Not competent. Lacks basic knowledge or skills. Requires constant supervision and significant guidance for simple tasks.

scale_rows.label: Learner
scale_rows.description: Little competence. Foundational knowledge; lacks practical experience. Routine tasks need frequent assistance.

scale_rows.label: Proficient
scale_rows.description: Competent. Works independently on standard tasks; solves common problems; meets expected requirements.

scale_rows.label: Advanced
scale_rows.description: Highly competent. Handles complex, non-routine situations; often a resource for others.

scale_rows.label: Exceptional
scale_rows.description: Expert/mastery. Recognized authority amongst peers; innovates, optimizes, mentors others.
